summary: Bimbel AELC backend smoke + integration testing via public URL. 22/22 checks passed: JWT login, /auth/me, protected endpoint 401 without token, Students CRUD with auto no_urut increment & sorted list, Teachers CRUD, Allocations CRUD with auto INV-AELC-YYYY-NNNN generation & payment_status update, Schedules CRUD with Mon-Fri validation, Dashboard stats fields & arithmetic (pendapatan aggregates Paid biaya correctly), cascade deletes (student -> allocations+schedules, teacher -> allocations+schedules).
passed: GET /api/auth/me returns admin user with Bearer token
Protected endpoints return 401 without Authorization header
POST /api/students auto-sets no_urut and increments correctly
POST /api/allocations auto-generates no_invoice in INV-AELC-YYYY-NNNN format when empty
GET /api/dashboard/stats returns all 6 fields with correct arithmetic (pendapatan sum of Paid biaya)
DELETE /api/students cascades to allocations and schedules
DELETE /api/teachers cascades to allocations and schedules
